content: pkgdown treats vignettes/articles/ as the canonical site-only subdirectory. Files placed there are built by build_articles() and rendered to articles/ (flattened — no double-nesting). usethis::use_article() automatically adds 'vignettes/articles' to .Rbuildignore. The required .Rbuildignore pattern is '^vignettes/articles'. Files in vignettes/tutorials/ are handled by build_tutorials() instead. Files starting with underscore are skipped (child document pattern). Lazy rebuild: only rebuilds if source newer than output. Articles in vignettes/articles/ become articles/my-article.html (not articles/articles/my-article.html) with automatic redirects.
